newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains down, hit by sterling rise.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains down, hit by sterling rise.

text.p: LIFFE grains futures fell in sterling dominated trade.
"There are still no other factors driving the market," one trader said.
Sterling climbed over three pfennigs to new 52-month peaks of 2.7460 marks on Tuesday and further gains are expected.
Grain traders said volume had been good, with active shipper sellers.
Active May wheat last traded 1.50 stg lower at 93.50 stg per tonne. May traded 560 lots of a total 938.
In barley March was most active, with 14 of the 19 lots traded. March last traded 1 stg lower at 92.00 stg.
